panels.description: Total number of Redkey custom resources managed across all namespaces (from kube-state-metrics).
panels.title: Total Redkeys

panels.description: Redkeys currently in the Ready phase.
panels.title: Ready

panels.description: Redkeys currently in the Configuring phase (an operation is in progress).
panels.title: Configuring

panels.description: Redkeys currently in the Error phase.
panels.title: Error

panels.description: Number of managed Redkeys in each phase over time (kube-state-metrics: redkey_phase).
panels.title: Phase Distribution

panels.description: Number of active RedkeyConfigs in each lifecycle phase over time (kube-state-metrics: redkey_config_phase).
panels.title: Config Phase Distribution

panels.description: Duration of control-plane operations (scaling, upgrade, rebalance, ...) from start until the cluster settles back to Ready — percentiles across the fleet.
panels.title: Operation Duration Percentiles

panels.description: Completed control-plane operations by type and result (increase per interval).
panels.title: Operations by Result

panels.description: Number of Redkeys currently running each operation type (in progress), across all clusters.
panels.title: Operations in Progress

panels.description: Reconcile failures by the stage that returned the error (redkey_reconcile_stage_errors_total), increase per interval. Pinpoints which part of the reconcile loop is failing.
panels.title: Reconcile Errors by Stage

panels.description: RedkeyConfig objects created by the operator by reason (redkey_config_creations_total): initial baseline vs spec/generation change. Increase per interval.
panels.title: Config Creations by Reason

panels.description: RedkeyConfig objects removed by the cleanup step (redkey_cleanup_deleted_configs_total), increase per interval. Counts configs actually deleted once a newer config becomes Applied — not configs currently in the Superseded phase, which may still exist until then.
panels.title: Configs Deleted by Cleanup

panels.description: Robin Deployment create and patch operations performed by the operator (redkey_robin_deployment_changes_total) by action, increase per interval. Sustained patches indicate persistent drift.
panels.title: Robin Deployment Changes

panels.description: Time from the active RedkeyConfig creation until the cluster reaches Ready (redkey_time_to_ready_seconds), percentiles across the fleet. Observed on every transition into Ready — initial provisioning and after each scaling/upgrade/rebalance.
panels.title: Time to Ready Percentiles

targets.expr: sum(rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_sum{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (controller) / sum(rate(controller_runtime_reconcile_time_seconds_count{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}[$__rate_interval])) by (controller)

panels.title: Queue Duration p95 vs Work Duration p95

targets.expr: go_memstats_mallocs_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"} - go_memstats_frees_total{job=~"$job", namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod"}

panels.title: Next GC Target vs Heap In-Use

targets.expr: sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container="manager"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod) / clamp_min(sum(rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container="manager"}[$__rate_interval])) by (pod), 0.000001)

sum(container_memory_working_set_bytes{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container="manager"}) by (pod) / clamp_min(sum(kube_pod_container_resource_limits{namespace=~"$namespace", pod=~"$pod", container="manager", resource="memory"}) by (pod), 1)
